_: The utility apps the shell (public/app/shell.js) draws; index.html is its Home (N18). Shape: docs/DESIGN-NOTES-2026-10.md Part 2.4. state built = route is a utility page; workshop = it exists only inside the workshop, so no route and a dashed chip (FIT Q3, I12); coming = not built. facts = an /api URL the shell GETs, answering { lines: [ 'text' | { text, tone:'dn' } ] } (at most two lines); null = no such read exists yet, so the card shows no figure (never an invented one) — the reads each card needs are listed in the N18 PR. rail = the Home widget: facts answers { suppliers, customers, in, out, stuck } (digits); route = where Open goes; null = not drawn. Every facts URL needs its line in the API's round-trips.budget.json (I19). pillar = the box an entry stands under on Home (CB Commerce): marketing · sales · finance · accounting (the main row) · operations · people · trade (the supporting row) · labs · setup; an entry has ONE pillar, so a card shows once; a missing pillar falls back to its area. area stays the roadmap's grouping. No 'tier' (Q5). OPTIONAL per entry, read by the index roadmap (never by the shell): rows = plan ids from MASTER-BUILD-2026-10.md (e.g. M30, R06; [] or absent = no row yet) · phase = its phase in that plan, as one short string (e.g. P3 books + payments) · fits = one short line on how it connects to the rail. works = true on a workshop row whose function works today (Connectors: Tally + Zoho): the roadmap says built while the shell still draws it as workshop. Plan ids are never printed on the page; the roadmap keeps them in a tooltip. The roadmap and the fit diagram on index.html are drawn from these rows only; state decides every chip.
editions_: AX1 (2026-10-13): an EDITION is which entries a showing draws — ONE map here, never a flag per entry, so a showing is read and changed in one place. key → { name (the avatar menu's word), chip (the header chip; absent on full), line (one line on Home saying what the view is for), entries: '*' | [ids] }. An id with no entry yet draws nothing (compare = the parallel-run compare, listed now, drawn when PR1 adds its entry). Read by public/app/edition.js (CBEdition) only. An edition HIDES, it never grants: the server still decides access.

auditor.name: Auditor view
auditor.line: For your auditor: the books, what is owed, the standards and the papers. Nothing here runs the shop.

entries.name: CB Marketing
entries.what: Reach customers and bring them back.
entries.fits: Marketing: the shop, offers and reach, one place.

entries.name: CB Finance
entries.what: Who owes you, who you owe, and when.
entries.fits: Finance: payment advice and reminders over the same chits.

entries.name: CB Operations
entries.what: Stock and suppliers.
entries.fits: Operations: stock from every receipt and sale, and the suppliers you order from.

entries.name: CB People

entries.name: Till

entries.name: Stock

entries.name: Delivery

entries.name: Documents

entries.name: CB Trade
entries.fits: Trade across borders: partner checks and forms, over the same chits.

entries.name: CB Employees

entries.name: Suppliers
